summary: Every Conditional Access policy now shows its persona, and moving from v1 is explained step by step.

new.title: Every policy shows its persona
new.text: A Conditional Access policy now shows a persona even when none of your managed personas takes it, taken from its template or its name. Your managed personas still come first.

new.title: Template library corrects persona names
new.text: Template library 2.0-v1.1 corrects persona spelling slips in 29 templates. Conditional Access > Template updates shows each change, old against new, for you to adopt.

new.title: Template personas are marked
new.text: In Manage personas, personas you do not manage yet are marked as coming from the template. Editing one makes it yours.

new.title: Get started explains moving from v1
new.text: Get started now opens with how to bring your v1 setup over: tagging rules in the browser, or everything with the import script, step by step.

new.title: Simpler analyzer form and rules list
new.text: The CA Policy Analyzer now reads long sign-in periods a day at a time by itself. Tagging Rules shows one run-order number per rule.
